authorization: Existing authorized original L_s/U_s simulated pairs, independent F-guided scratch single30 and complete Main seven-view evaluation; no parameter limit.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU5 only; admission at most one existing GPU compute PID and free>=12288MiB. Monitor every 2s; stop only own child if total>3 or GPU count unavailable three times.

Otherwise final30 and complete Main7/truth-last.

rows.purpose: Test whether preserving original F0 continuous feature differences of source perturbations improves task-relevant restoration beyond IQ response alone.
rows.seed_notes: Physical2026092701/confidence2026092702, original source order2026110102 and R07 draws. Existing source subset2026110707. No new stochastic prior fit.
rows.budget_ref: Scratch single30/7410, same ResponseDense initialization, source order, prior, IQ response and objective; adds .01 feature response with source-variance scale and a fixed reference-energy denominator floor.

notes: Fixed source-only 224-row study found F0 response errors in synthetic directions, including high and broadly distributed phase-slope errors. Synthetic directions do not establish actual TX hardware derivatives or an information limit.

Feature response equals F0(G(y+Aδ))-F0(G(y)) minus [F0(x+δ)-F0(x)], variance-normalized; denominator uses reference response energy plus 1e-4 source feature energy and minimum 1e-12. The added term has weight .01.

Same original ResponseDense E0, priors, optimizer, schedule, data and IQ response; no control weights loaded. The extra two differentiable F0 passes and one detached clean-perturbed F0 pass per source row are explicitly counted.

Eleven focused local tests PASS, including actual objective gradients in a synthetic model and technical recovery regression. One independent P0/P1 review PASS. Real F0/source2/E0/feature-response-gradient smoke is the first remote step and is not yet passed.
Both Main populations and all seven views are predicted before independent truth-last. No target result is used to adjust this or another candidate. Default DURA unchanged.
